personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT fused with functional ledger utility
personality_one_liner: A warm, paper-toned, Indian-vernacular digital bahi-khata that feels traditional but acts modern.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for reading entries clearly, but functional grid padding for quick actions.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism to preserve the traditional flat paper bahi-khata aesthetic

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Google Sign-In screen introducing the shop's brand.
screens.layout: Centered layout with app logo/title in Noto Serif Devanagari. A large Google Sign-In button near the bottom third. Paper texture background.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard to instantly view today's financial summary and pending jobs.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for the stat cards.
states.empty: No data yet illustration, prompt to add first customer.
states.error: Error card with a retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Top section: 2x2 grid of stat cards (Total Due in Brick Red, Today's Udhaar, Today's Jama in Forest Green, Pending Jobs). Middle: 'Top 5 Due Customers' list (flat rows with trailing balances). Bottom: 'Recent Entries' list. Floating Action Button (FAB) hidden here to avoid clutter; use tabs.

screens.name: Customers
screens.purpose: Directory of all customers with their running balances.

states.empty: Open notebook illustration (empty state), 'कोई ग्राहक नहीं' (No customers) message.

screens.layout: Sticky top search bar. A scrollable horizontal row of filter chips (All, Due, Clear). FlatList of customers: Each row shows Avatar (initials), Name, Phone, and right-aligned Balance (Colored Red or Green). Fixed FAB at bottom right to 'Add Customer'.

screens.name: CustomerDetail
screens.purpose: View a single customer's ledger timeline and add new entries.
screens.layout: Top sticky header with Name and Phone. A large hero card showing current balance ('कुल बकाया' or 'जमा') prominently. Below hero card, a 3-button horizontal split for quick actions: 'उधार' (Red), 'जमा' (Green), 'काम' (Teal) triggering bottom sheets. The rest of the screen is a vertical timeline of transactions (running ledger). Delete button hidden in header options.

screens.name: WorkList
screens.layout: Filter chips at the top (Pending, Done, All). List of job cards showing job description, date, status, and associated customer. FAB at bottom right to 'Add Job'.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User account, sync status, and logout.
screens.layout: Simple list of settings: User profile info from Google, Sync Status indicator, and a Logout button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette to maintain the traditional 'bahi-khata' aesthetic: Brick Red (#C62828) for Udhaar/Dues/Given and Forest Green (#2E7D32) for Jama/Payments/Taken. These are functional status colors, DO NOT use blue.
Use 'Noto Serif Devanagari' for all display headings (titles, balance amounts, key labels) and 'Hind' for all other text. This pairing creates the authentic traditional-yet-modern feel.
Data entry must be fast. Keep 'Add Udhaar' and 'Add Jama' forms simple and within a bottom sheet (`@gorhom/bottom-sheet`) to avoid context switching.
Ensure all text is mapped correctly to Hindi (Devanagari). Example: घर, ग्राहक, काम, खाता for bottom tabs.
Do not use glassmorphism effects. The aesthetic is paper-like (Editorial Mobile LIGHT), so rely on subtle surface color shifts (surface to surfaceSecondary) and border dividers.
Implement Google Sign-In on the Login screen and ensure state persists online as requested by the user.
For avatars of customers, use initials (e.g., 'र.क.' for Ravi Kumar) inside a brandTertiary circle as the default fallback.
